biw_news.title: India-Made Renault Kiger Achieves 4-Star Global NCAP Crashworthiness Rating
biw_news.summary: The Renault Kiger has significantly improved its structural safety performance, upgrading from a 2-star to a 4-star Global NCAP rating. This enhancement reflects vital improvements in occupant protection and body shell integrity during frontal and side impact crash deformations.

biw_news.title: KTM X-Bow Arrow Lightweight Tubular Chassis and Audi Powertrain Integration
biw_news.summary: Austrian lightweight specialist KTM has revealed its new side-by-side platform, combining an ultra-light tubular spaceframe chassis with a rigid suspension setup. The vehicle's architecture is engineered to handle high torsional loads while accommodating a robust Audi-sourced turbo four powertrain.

biw_news.title: Mercedes-AMG GT 63 SUV Platform Architecture and Mass Management
biw_news.summary: The independently developed Mercedes-AMG GT 63 SUV utilizes a heavily reinforced multi-material chassis to manage its substantial 2.7-tonne mass and tri-motor electric layout. Structural engineers deployed advanced load paths and stiffened subframes to maintain dynamic rigidity under extreme torque loads.

biw_news.title: Genesis GV90 Monocoque Platform Patented for Upcoming EV Architecture
biw_news.summary: Hyundai has officially patented the flagship Genesis GV90 luxury electric SUV structure in international markets, highlighting its skateboard EV platform. The architecture integrates heavy battery structural enclosures to enhance torsional rigidity and cabin crash deformation resistance.

biw_news.title: Hero Vida NEX 3 Micro-EV Spaceframe Architecture and Gullwing Door Integration
biw_news.summary: Hero MotoCorp has patented the Vida NEX 3 micro electric vehicle featuring a compact spaceframe configuration adapted for gullwing doors. Designing access apertures with unconventional swing mechanisms requires specialized pillar reinforcements and roof rail load-bearing nodes to preserve structural stiffness.

biw_news.title: Rolls-Royce Spectre Aluminum Spaceframe Architecture and Battery Integration
biw_news.summary: The Rolls-Royce Spectre relies on an advanced all-aluminum spaceframe architecture that integrates the heavy high-voltage battery pack as a core structural element. This bonded and riveted multi-material chassis achieves exceptional torsional rigidity while effectively managing the vehicle's immense gross mass.
